== English errata comparison sources ==
Changes any starship to anything he pilots. Training bonus, Tallon Roll protection and asteroid-sector exemption remain. Face shows unique, destiny 2, power 2, ability 2, deploy 3, forfeit 4 and Pilot throughout.
